Name: Weather Clouds
Author: Luminte
Description:
[size=3]The cloud can be placed on a wall and will change based on the weather of the day, the cloud is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23868]Weather Wonders[/url] and has custom sprites for all of the weather.

[size=3]Both the Weather Cloud and Moon Tracker can be purchased at The Egg Festival for 1500g or at Robin's for 5000g[/size]

The Moon Tracker is an optional addition for people who have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19428]Moon Cycle[/url]﻿ installed. (Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS]AirynS[/url]﻿ for letting me use his Moon sprites in this mod)

[/size]
[size=3]Installation:

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Install the latest versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens (CMCT) [/url][/size]
[*][size=3](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23868]Weather Wonders[/url]﻿ and/or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19428]Moon Cycle[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Install Weather Clouds[/size]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Added a new Moon Tracker which requires Moon Cycle to be added and Weather Wonders Compatibility for the Weather Cloud and Moon Tracker. Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens (CMCT) is now Required. (1.1.0 didn't have Moon Tracker in shops. oops...)
